viewing_check: Confirm the back is incised John Campbell and Tas (the photo shows '...Campbell / Tas' and 'MID'); check the pale spot low on the back, the hanging hole and the rim edge for chips. No other plain John Campbell wall pocket of this size sold in the last 24 months turned up. The only one was sold with a Remued piece for A$160 the pair (Dec 2024); decorated ones sit higher (map, A$320 sold; koala, A$450-550 estimate).
